title: Documentation: get the json result of the research for export.
body:
Hi,
Documentation is a bite confuse on how to get the json response of the search queries  and how to log it in the console ( for test ).
I want to extract in another format (like csv ) the entire result of my research (with some of my facets  and my slider engaged), not just the current page result.
Exemple my querie return 500 results on 50 pages with 10 hitPerPage, i want the 500 results.
Maybe TransformData on the hit widget it's a clue, but honestly i'm little lost with this.
Thx :)

comments.body: Thank you for your rapid reply, i will try that ;)
